title: The Lord of the Rings — The journey begins
source: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001)

hook.quote: Even the smallest person can change the course of the future.
hook.context: Elflar malikasi Galadriel qo'rqib turgan Frodoga shunday deydi: kichkina hobbit ham dunyo taqdirini o'zgartira oladi. "the smallest" — orttirma daraja, "the course of the future" — kelajak yo'nalishi.

reading: Frodo is a hobbit, a small, peaceful person who loves food, gardens and a quiet life. His uncle Bilbo gives him a gold ring before he leaves the Shire.

The wizard Gandalf discovers that it is the One Ring, made by the dark lord Sauron. If Sauron gets it back, he will rule the whole world. The ring can only be destroyed in the fire of Mount Doom, where it was made.
Frodo is scared, but he says, "I'm going to take it." His loyal friend Sam immediately decides to go with him.
In the town of Rivendell, a council meets to discuss the danger. Nine companions agree to help: hobbits, men, an elf, a dwarf and a wizard. They become the Fellowship of the Ring.
The journey is long and dangerous. The ring is heavy and it slowly changes the people who carry it. Even good people want to take it for themselves.
In the dark mines of Moria the Fellowship loses Gandalf. Later Boromir tries to take the ring, and Frodo understands that the ring will destroy the Fellowship.
So he makes a hard choice. "I'm leaving tomorrow," he thinks, "and I will go alone." But Sam refuses to let him go alone, and the two friends continue the journey together.

grammar.title: Kelasi zamon: will, going to, Present Continuous
explain: **will** — gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror, va'da yoki bashorat: "I **will** go alone." If Sauron gets it, he **will** rule the world.
**be going to** — oldindan o'ylangan reja yoki ko'rinib turgan dalilga asoslangan bashorat: "I'**m going to** take it." Look at the clouds — it**'s going to** rain.
**Present Continuous** — aniq kelishilgan, vaqti belgilangan reja: "I**'m leaving** tomorrow." We**'re meeting** the council at six.
Qisqa qoida: qaror shu daqiqada → will; avvaldan niyat → going to; kalendarga yozilgan → Present Continuous.
